thread:
Eve Park: Quick design huddle. Proposal: stamp "owner_id" on ingest (before writing to billing.events) so subscribers can read attribution early. Idea is to make assignment deterministic and auditable. Short doc: https://short.redwood/ingest-stamp-v1

Danielle Ruiz: What are the hard constraints? i.e., do we care more about zero-late-reassignments or minimal p99 impact?

Eve Park: Priorities: 1) reduce reconciliation noise (fewer post-hoc reassigns), 2) let downstream consumers (metrics, rate-limiter) consume owner without waiting for post-process. Latency increase must be <10ms p99 ideally.

Noah Kim: How do we avoid races if two ingest replicas see same event concurrently?

Eve Park: Deterministic tie-breaker: compute fingerprint = sha256(tenant_id + event_body + producer_offset). Assignment key = (fingerprint, node_uuid, local_counter). Winner = lowest lexicographic tuple. Each ingest node exposes `node_uuid` and increments `local_counter` monotonically.

Priya Shah: Example envelope?

Eve Park:``` 
{
  "event_id": "evt-20260321-9001",
  "tenant_id": "t-451",
  "tokens": 320,
  "owner": {
    "owner_id": "acct:900",
    "assignment_ver": "1",
    "prov": "node:us1-a:cnt:124:sha:abc123"
  }
}
```

Danielle Ruiz: If later we decide the owner was wrong (dispute), how do we record that without mutating billing.events?

Eve Park: Emit to `billing.assignments.audit` topic an append-only record `assignment_delta` referencing the original `event_id`. Ledger (`billing.charges`) remains append-only; reconciler can apply policy.

infra-bot: Note: For production deploy, set cache replica_count=3 and cache_ttl=14d for short history. Quorum reads recommended.

Noah Kim: How big is the per-tenant cache? Could blow up with high-cardinality tenants.

Eve Park: We'll shard cache by tenant hash and cap entries per-tenant (LRU). Hot tenants get pinned. Default per-tenant cap=10k keys, evict oldest. We'll also expose `cache_hit` metric.

Priya Shah: Testing plan? real-time race tests + replay + backfill?

Eve Park: Yes. Tests: replay idempotency (producer dupes), cross-region conflict, TTL expiry. Use `fake-time` harness for TTLs. Also load test p99 delta.

Danielle Ruiz: Backfill story? we need to populate cache to avoid emitting huge deltas when feature flips on.

Eve Park: Streaming backfill job will compute canonical owner from historical post-process outputs and write `assignment_delta` only where canonical != stamped. Backfill will write progress to `backfill.checkpoints` with per-tenant offsets. We'll rate-limit by tenant QPS.

Noah Kim: What about provisional owners for latency-sensitive callers? e.g., embedding path which needs owner fast.

Eve Park: Provide `owner_provisional=true` flag when stamp is based on heuristics or cache miss. Billing finalization requires assignment_ver confirmation or TTL expiry (configurable, default 5m). Provisional assignments are excluded from invoice generation.

Priya Shah: Ops playbook items? cache evictions, audit consumer lag, backfill failover.

Marta Ruiz: I'll add runbook entries: 1) detect >1% provisional rate — alert, 2) audit-topic lag >5m — page, 3) cache evict storm — throttle ingest for affected tenants.

Danielle Ruiz: Metrics to surface: assignment_churn_rate, provisional_fraction, assignment_delta_per_1k_events, cache_hit_rate, backfill_progress_pct.

Noah Kim: Instrumentation: add traces with attrs `assignment.fingerprint`, `assignment.node`, `assignment.path` and span event `assignment.delta_emitted`.

Eve Park: Security note: provenance contains node_uuid and counters; scrub sensitive fields. We'll HMAC the provenance string with service key before emitting to audits.

infra-bot: Deploy note: new feature flag `INGEST_OWNER_STAMP=true` controlled by tenant. Rollout plan: internal tenants -> beta orgs -> GA. Canary traffic 1% -> 10% -> 50%.

Priya Shah: Action items:
- Eve: PR with prototype + config flags + default cache params (target: Thu)
- Noah: add instrumentation & HMAC provenance (target: Fri)
- Marta: runbook + alerts (target: next Tue)
- Danielle: metrics dashboard skeleton + sample alerts (target: Fri)
- Priya: e2e harness + fake-time tests (target: Mon)

Danielle Ruiz: One more: add a CLI to kick off backfill per-tenant: `rb backfill --tenant t-XXX --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-20 --rate 100/s`.

Eve Park: Will add CLI and docs. Thanks everyone — will post PR link when ready :thumbsup:\"
